opening_message.content: Grace, you would like to exchange the mechanical keyboard on household order #W2378156 for a clicky-switch version with RGB backlight, full size. The replacement is more expensive than the per-secondary cap, so you will need to coordinate with the primary holder's assistant before the exchange can be authorized. Coordinate efficiently within the turn budget and do not leave any required authorization or consent step implicit; ambiguous requests should be clarified before action.
